What pain does it have to hold the birth certificate and death certificate of your children on the same day? God is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs 💔 💔 💔 💔

As usual, a large number are killed when the disaster strikes, and another number gradually succumbs to their wounds after it occurs. Omar Al-Jaabari, 13 years old, died of his wounds at Kamal Adwan Hospital. He was among the victims of the massacre at Al-Tabaeen School two days ago. Omar suffered severe burns as a result of the American missiles that produce very high temperatures, and he was not directly injured, otherwise he would have been turned into pieces and his body would have melted. 💔 💔 💔
Imagine for a moment in time that this is your child? How would you feel about the Zionists?
